claims.value: Note petroglyphs of canoes (vaka), one with outrigger.

notes.text: Image 44 reproduces Mathew James Harrison's 1868 drawing and identifies the depicted pukao with the Easter Island Statue Project number 4-137-001. The preceding text says that Harrison recorded pukao at Puna Pau with incised crescent, bird or komari forms. Image 45 reproduces Harrison's other pukao drawing and compares its motifs with Hoa Hakananai'a and a woodcarving, but supplies no individual pukao identifier; that second drawing therefore remains unlinked. The British Museum Research Repository's open copy and publication record were reviewed on 30 September 2026.
